title: English National Ballet (Over 50s)
intro: ENB is on a break until after the Summer.

image.alt: Ballet class in the Toynbee Hall Community Centre

sections.text: This is a LinkAge Plus activity for people aged 50+.
Come join us on Thursdays at 10:15am for an hour of gentle yet active ballet, aimed at loosening and stretching painful muscles, reducing chronic pain, decreasing stress, and improving circulation.
Spaces are limited and are allocated on a first come, first serve basis. Please arrive on time, entry will not be allowed 10 minutes after the class has begun for health and safety reasons.
